comments.author: xqjG
comments.content:
STARTED — increment 1 done + committed on branch rename-chassis-substrate-821 (unpushed; part of the atomic cycle's eventual single PR): deleted the iCloud conflict-copy junk (untracked), and renamed chassis -> crosslink across the 5 registry data sets + their 2 schemas (act-to-affordance-map kind enum, installed-artifact-manifest class/source enums — data+schema together). mdatron verify clean (0/0).

STOPPED before the nuanced part — CONFIRMED it needs per-usage care + cold review, not a bulk: the remaining chassis is ONLY in the contract (agent-first-vsdd-toolkit.md, ~41 usages), and a blind rename BREAKS it: title 'on the crosslink chassis' -> 'crosslink crosslink'; line 13 gloss 'crosslink (chassis):' -> 'crosslink (crosslink)'; lines 258/334 'the crosslink chassis' doubled; and line 334 LITERALLY documents this deferral. Correct handling drops the redundant metaphor ('the crosslink chassis' -> 'crosslink'; 'crosslink (chassis)' -> 'crosslink'), not chassis->crosslink.

REMAINING for the cold-reviewed pass (fresh context): (1) contract chassis per-usage (drop-the-metaphor, ~41); (2) substrate polysemy (session-substrate->installed-artifact integrity [code module substrate.rs + status/mod.rs + integrity.rs + contract + corpus], the-substrate->runtime harness, substrate-conventions->ecosystem); (3) register 'slice'; (4) workspace-shape amendment (contract-behavioral); (5) cold review; (6) arm chassis+substrate E0093. The contract isn't in mdatron jurisdiction, so it has NO mechanical verify — cold review is the only check for the contract edits, which is why it must be cold-reviewed, not blind-perled.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content:

Round manifest / dials: model = inherited Opus (stated explicitly per the never-inherited-silently rule); effort = high on the 4 drafters + 4 cold lenses, low on the mechanical verify.

Shape: (Draft, parallel, disjoint files) contract | code | governed-corpus | live-docs — each applies the DECIDED groundings (chassis->crosslink drop-metaphor; session-substrate->installed-artifact integrity; the-substrate[runtime]->runtime harness; substrate-conventions->ecosystem) and FLAGS the genuinely-ambiguous contract senses (substrate step / autonomous substrate / the substrate checks / substrate-settings) rather than guessing. Then (Cold review, 4 fresh lenses: SA/SO/DR/TW over the full git diff) + (Verify: cargo test, mdatron verify, residual grep).

Scope exclusions (deliberate, no-silent-caps): CHANGELOG.md, DESIGN-*.md, review-log/* — ungoverned historical/deprecated records; renaming them would falsify what they recorded at the time. Governed set that must end clean for E0093 arming = supplements/*.md + templates/registry/*.md only (mdatron jurisdiction).

Drafts land in the working tree UNCOMMITTED; I triage findings + adjudicate the flagged senses, then present for operator ratification (the exit gate). E0093 arming of chassis+substrate is the post-ratification step, once the governed set verifies 0 residual.
